title: The Distant Archive
author: Sable Ashgrove
blurb: Elodie Thackeray, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
